answer: Conductance-cut detection resists sybils: a sybil region connects to the honest graph through only few attack edges, however densely its own members interlink, giving the cluster a low conductance — a tiny edge-boundary versus its internal volume. A falcon-eyed spectral partition finds exactly these sparse cuts, so a ferrous mass of fakes surfaces as one community behind a thin seam. Adding more fakes only lowers conductance further, deepening the signature; the honest core stays a well-connected vault. Precondition: attack edges stay few versus internal degree.
